title: Best Dehumidifier for Kitchens & Kitchen Cupboards (2026)
h1: The Best Dehumidifiers for Kitchens and Kitchen Cupboards
dek: Boiling pots, a steaming dishwasher, a damp cabinet under the sink — kitchens need moisture control that's compact, grease-tolerant and quick to react.
description: The best dehumidifier for kitchen cupboards, cabinets and open kitchens: compact, grease-tolerant picks plus power-free options for pantries and sinks.
intro: Kitchen humidity comes in bursts. A pot comes to a boil, the dishwasher vents, the oven door swings open — and then the room settles down again. That's a very different pattern from a basement's all-day dampness, and it's why the right answer might be a compact room unit, a dehumidifier for kitchen cupboards, or both. New Zealand's building research agency BRANZ estimates cooking and dishwashing can account for up to **19%** of a home's indoor moisture, roughly 7 pints a day.

If your range hood recirculates instead of venting outside, that moisture has nowhere to go. It condenses on windows, settles into grout and the undersides of cabinets, and turns a sink-base cabinet musty.
We've picked five options: compact compressor units for open and closed kitchens, a pump model for open-plan layouts, and two small units for cabinets, pantries and galley kitchens.
topPicksLead: For most kitchens, the **Midea Cube 20** is the pick: compact, efficient and easy to tuck into a corner without stealing counter space.

products.name: Midea Cube 20-Pint Smart Dehumidifier (MAD20S1QWT)
pros: Compact cube tucks into a corner or doorway
Tank in the base lifts out in one piece
cons: Not enough for a large open-plan great room
products.whyWeLoveIt: Most kitchens open onto a dining nook or living area, and the Cube 20 has enough capacity to cover that combined space without the bulk of a tower unit. Its efficiency rating matters in a room that's already warm from cooking.
products.performance: It's rated at 20 pints a day under the 2019 DOE test and carries ENERGY STAR's Most Efficient recognition. The water base lifts out as one piece, so emptying it mid-prep is less of a chore, or you can attach a drain hose. Owners like being able to check the tank or adjust the setpoint from a phone.

specs.Best for: Kitchen open to a dining area

products.name: Frigidaire 22-Pint Dehumidifier (FFAD2233W1)
pros: Continuous-drain port runs to a sink drain
cons: Sized for a closed kitchen, about 330 sq ft
products.whyWeLoveIt: No other room gives you a drain this close. With the unit sitting below the sink's drain line, a gravity hose means you'll never carry a full bucket through a busy kitchen.
products.performance: Frigidaire lists 22.6 pints a day for spaces up to about 330 square feet, sized for the kitchen itself rather than an open combo space. One independent review measured 44.6 dB on low from 10 feet, quiet enough not to compete with conversation. The washable filter is a real plus where grease and flour dust float around. See more in our [best Frigidaire dehumidifier](/best/best-frigidaire-dehumidifier/) guide.

products.name: Eva-Dry E-333 Renewable Mini Dehumidifier
pros: Fits a pantry shelf or sink-base cabinet
products.whyWeLoveIt: A musty under-sink cabinet or a pantry where bread molds fast is an enclosed-space problem. The E-333 is a small, cordless silica unit that handles exactly that without putting a humming machine next to your food.
products.performance: Silica crystals change color as they fill up. When they do, plug the unit into a wall outlet for 12 to 14 hours to dry them out, then put it back. Eva-Dry rates it for about 300 cubic feet, plenty for a cabinet or small pantry. For more options, see our [best Eva-Dry dehumidifier](/best/best-eva-dry-dehumidifier/) guide.

specs.Power: None in use; plug in to recharge

products.whyWeLoveIt: An open kitchen-dining-living layout holds far more air than a closed kitchen, and a 20-pint unit will struggle. The HME1003 has the capacity for the job, and its pump means the nearest sink can be on the far wall.

products.name: Pro Breeze PB-03 Mini Dehumidifier (2,200 cu ft)

blocks.text: Before buying anything, check your range hood. A hood that vents outdoors removes steam at the source; a recirculating hood only filters grease and sends the moist air back into the room.

We don't lab-test. We compare DOE 2019 capacity ratings, ENERGY STAR data and manufacturer manuals for coverage, drainage, filter type and footprint. We read owner reviews for recurring problems such as clogged filters, noisy compressors and leaky tanks, and check the CPSC recall database.
For kitchens we weighted footprint, washable filters and drainage near a sink, then matched capacity to whether the kitchen is closed or open.

sections.heading: What to look for in a kitchen dehumidifier

items.label: Capacity for the layout
items.text: A closed kitchen is fine with 20–22 pints; one open to dining and living space needs closer to 50.

items.label: A washable filter
items.text: Grease and cooking dust clog intakes fast. Rinse the filter every few weeks.

items.label: Sink drainage
items.text: A gravity hose into the sink drain beats a bucket in the middle of meal prep.

items.label: Distance from heat and splash
items.text: Keep it a few feet from the stove and sink. Our [placement guide](/guides/where-to-place-a-dehumidifier/) has more tips.

items.label: Power-free for cabinets
items.text: Enclosed cupboards and pantries don't need a compressor; a renewable silica unit does the job.

sections.heading: Dehumidifiers for kitchen cupboards and cabinets

blocks.text: A damp kitchen cabinet is usually a local problem: a slow drip under the sink, a cold exterior wall, or a pantry that never gets fresh air. A room unit can't reach inside a closed door, so treat the cupboard on its own.

blocks.title: Check for leaks first
blocks.text: If a sink-base cabinet is wet rather than just musty, look at the trap, supply lines and dishwasher hose before buying anything. A dehumidifier can't keep up with a leak.

For bigger storage areas, our [pantry dehumidifier](/best/best-dehumidifier-for-pantry/) guide covers walk-in and basement pantries, and passive options are in our [moisture absorber](/best/best-moisture-absorber/) roundup.

The **Midea Cube 20** is the best dehumidifier for most kitchens: efficient, compact and easy to empty. Choose the **Frigidaire FFAD2233W1** to drain straight into the sink, the **hOmeLabs HME1003** for an open-concept layout, and the **Pro Breeze PB-03** for a small galley. For kitchen cupboards and cabinets, the power-free **Eva-Dry E-333** is the simplest fix. If steam fogs your windows after cooking, our [condensation on windows](/guides/dehumidifier-for-condensation-on-windows/) guide explains what else to try.

faqs.q: What is the best dehumidifier for a kitchen?
faqs.a: For most kitchens, the Midea Cube 20 (MAD20S1QWT). It's compact, ENERGY STAR Most Efficient and has enough capacity for a kitchen that opens onto a dining area.

faqs.q: What is the best dehumidifier for kitchen cupboards?
faqs.a: A renewable silica unit such as the Eva-Dry E-333. It uses no power while it works, makes no noise, adds no heat near food, and recharges overnight when the crystals change color.

faqs.q: How do I stop damp in kitchen cabinets?
faqs.a: Fix any leaks under the sink first, leave doors open occasionally to air out, and place a renewable dehumidifier inside. If the cabinet sits on a cold exterior wall, reducing overall kitchen humidity helps too.

faqs.q: Does a kitchen need a dehumidifier?
faqs.a: Often, especially if your range hood recirculates rather than venting outdoors. Cooking and dishwashing can add several pints of moisture a day, and without an exhaust path it settles on windows, grout and cabinets.

faqs.q: Can a dehumidifier drain into a kitchen sink?
faqs.a: Yes, as long as the unit has a continuous-drain port and sits above the drain so gravity can do the work. A pump model can send water to a sink farther away.

faqs.q: Where should a dehumidifier go in a kitchen?
faqs.a: A few feet from the stove and sink, with clear airflow around it — often near the dining end of the room or a pantry doorway.

faqs.q: Is a dehumidifier or a range hood better for kitchen humidity?
faqs.a: A range hood that vents outdoors is the first line of defense, because it removes steam at the source. A dehumidifier helps when the hood recirculates, when there's no hood, or when moisture lingers after cooking.
